entries.title: Your iPhone and iPad stay smooth when you reopen Infinitary
entries.body: When you came back to Infinitary on your iPhone or iPad after a while away, it could stutter for several seconds while it caught up with your computer. The Tasks list no longer rebuilds while another tab shows, so a large board catches up without the stutter.
entries.noPicture: The screens look the same; the change is how much work the phone does while it catches up.
